name: Fujian Snowman Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Snowman Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture of cooling, heating, and new energy equipment in China and internationally. The company provides screw and reciprocating compressors; and ice machines, heat exchangers, pressure vessels, power plants, hydrogen fuel cell air compressor and project cases. Its products are used in commercial refrigeration, industrial refrigeration, vaccine cold chain, hydrogen energy CO2 refrigeration, air conditioning, ice machine, cold chain logistics, ice and snow sports, marine refrigeration, and waste heat recovery power generation. The company offers its products under the SNOWKEY, SRM, Refcomp, and Opcon brand names. Fujian Snowman Group Co., Ltd.…
